text:
alyssa: noticed a few tenants seeing doubled rows in invoice PREVIEW window at ~03:12 UTC. Final invoices look deduped, but support tickets are spiking. Leaving notes here to coordinate fixes.

sam: confirmed in ingest traces. pattern: provisional metering emitted without epoch_id, joiner commits epoch later. preview pipeline shows both because dedupe is eventual. sample log:```
2026-03-22T03:12:01Z INFO ingest req=ri_7a1 epoch=null route=embed-heavy tokens=210 status=queued
2026-03-22T03:12:02Z INFO joiner req=ri_7a1 epoch=ep-20260322-03 tokens=210 status=committed
```

mira: ugh. users see two preview lines and panic. quick question: how many minutes before dedupe runs in canonical pipeline?
jordan: canonical ledger dedupe runs in batch later (up to ~15m) so previews can be noisy. Current dedupe key is request_id only which fails for retries that generate new ids.

alyssa: i want a 3-track plan: immediate UX mitigation, medium infra change, and experiments for long-term solution. proposals?

mira: immediate UX: add a preview-side collapse that groups rows by client_request_id or by request fingerprint if a matching final commit arrives within 5m. show a tiny badge "provisional" for hidden items so transparency is preserved. low-risk and reversible.
sam: medium infra: two parts. (A) Edge attaches `provisional_epoch` when deterministically known, with a small optional wait (configurable per-route). (B) Pass `x-client-request-id` from SDK to avoid new ids on retries. Also add `metering.provisional_emit` and `metering.preview_duplicate` telemetry.
jordan: implementation detail: instead of waiting in the edge too long (which hurts p50), we can implement a shadow preview path: emit provisional events to a shadow preview stream (not shown in UI) and only show preview if final or after a short debounce window. That lets us measure tradeoffs without impacting users.

alyssa: shadow-preview sounds neat. how would we do rollout?
jordan: Canary by tenant segment: send 5% of traffic to shadow-on, compare preview_duplicate_rate, support-ticket-rate, and p50 latency. If metrics look good, flip route-level toggle. Add a console toggle called "consistent-preview (shadow|on)".
mira: console UX: modal language suggestion: "Consistent preview: hide provisional preview rows until they are finalized. This reduces duplicate preview items shown to your users. May increase median request latency by a small amount for this route." Also show an explainability link to telemetry dashboard.

sam: technotes: for dedupe we should migrate dedupe-store to Redis with a Lua script that atomically upserts (dedupe_key -> epoch, last_seen) and returns whether a duplicate preview should be emitted. This will let preview dedupe be low-latency and consistent across consumers. Add TTL to keep Redis small (e.g., 48h) and partition by tenant to avoid hot keys.

ops-bot: INC-4821 muted alerts for affected tenant cohort while we triage :information_source:

mira: medium-term UX change: show collapsed row with combined token count and a tooltip explaining it was collapsed due to pending commit; allow expansion to show provisional and final lines for audit. Keep an audit log link to raw events.
jordan: edge feature flag: `edge.provisional_wait_ms` default 0, route override possible. start with 50ms for billing-sensitive routes, measure p50 delta. Also add `metering.provisional_wait_ms` histogram.
sam: SDKs: we'll standardize `x-client-request-id` header across SDKs (JS, Python, Go). If absent, edge will generate but include original retry-id if available. Need to update docs and cherrypick to older SDK releases used by customers.

alyssa: owners: mira -> console collapse + modal copy + audit expand; sam -> edge + SDK header + telemetry counters; jordan -> dedupe redis-lua + shadow preview pipeline + e2e tests. I'll coordinate canary windows and notify support.
mira: i'll draft modal copy and a small help center blurb. Also will add an Admin toggle in route settings with a short latency estimate.
sam: PRs: edge WIP: https://git.redwood.company/edge-proxy/pulls/820 (feature-flagged). SDK RFC will be posted to devex.
jordan: metering WIP: https://git.redwood.company/metering/pulls/141 (includes Redis Lua script and shadow preview consumer). E2E harness simulates late-join ordering and retry id changes.

alyssa: monitoring: create a transient dashboard for the canary showing: `preview_duplicate_rate by route`, `p50 latency by route`, `support_ticket_rate for preview` (via tags), and `metering.provisional_wait_ms`. Ops will watch and abort if preview_duplicate_rate doesn't drop or p50 spikes >10%

mira: small UX nit: add an "audit" checkbox to show provisional rows in preview for customer support only (permissioned), so support can always see raw events without toggling route-level behavior.
sam: corner case: streaming requests where tokens accumulate across messages. need dedupe logic to key on stream_session_id + client_request_id. I'll add an item in PR.
jordan: also ensure we don't change final invoice semantics. Preview collapse must not affect canonical ledger emission. Keep preview-only logic strictly downstream of canonical emit path.

ops-bot: creating ticket INC-4823 to track canary rollout and automated rollback hooks

alyssa: timeline: console quick collapse (mira) today as opt-in for support. shadow preview pipeline and Redis dedupe (jordan) + edge flag behind feature flag (sam) in 48-72h. Canary 7 days starting with 5% tenants -> ramp to 100% if stable.
mira: posting modal mock + PR link shortly.
sam: will coordinate SDK header rollout with devex.
jordan: will add metrics and alert rules for `preview_duplicate_rate` drop and `metering.redis_dedupe_errors`.

alyssa: thanks all. reconvene 11:00 PT tomorrow in #eng-platform with PR links and canary plan. If anyone sees new spikes, tag me with sample request_id and raw log line. :thumbsup:
